title: Small glyph / corner scale and margin

location.series: Elvis Dinh / Instagram brand design system / project year 2022

slide_intent: Coordinate a corner signature’s size and inset so it remains visible without taking over the message.
strategic_value: A repeatable small signature can identify Instagram while leaving room for content.
demonstration: A small upper-right glyph is compared with a five-part height stack; later guides mark top and right offsets as 1/12 X.
practical_value: Separate the glyph’s one-fifth scale relation from the one-twelfth inset relation.

content_islands.name: Small corner glyph
content_islands.spec: Position the active gradient glyph at upper right on white.

content_islands.name: Measurement overlays
content_islands.spec: Show a vertical five-glyph stack, field-height arrow and dotted inset guides in the sequence.

reference_purposes.Application: The animation locates a small glyph relative to its canvas.
reference_purposes.Constraint: The displayed diagram labels glyph height 1/5 X and inset guides 1/12 X.

ingredient.name: Small corner glyph
ingredient.role: Identify the brand while keeping the central composition available.
ingredient.application: Use the demonstrated 1/5 X glyph height and 1/12 X top/right inset when reproducing this construction.
ingredient.scope: This small-glyph demonstration; the drawing defines X as the field height.
